name: B10-0435/2026 – After § 15 – Am 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the state of play of advancing EU-Africa trade and investment relations
part_text: 15a. Condemns the corrupt practices followed by certain EU companies operating in African countries, in particular where such practices are linked to the award of public contracts, concessions or access to strategic infrastructure; calls on the Commission and the Member States to strengthen transparency, corporate accountability and anti-corruption requirements applicable to EU companies investing in Africa;
